subject: maths
question: Who is authorised to conduct road tests on workshop vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Only trained and certified personnel__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Only trained and certified personnel are authorised to conduct road tests on workshop vehicles.
 
• This ensures the safety of the tester and others, as well as maintaining the integrity of the vehicle.
 
• Untrained personnel, including visitors, accountants, or general employees, are not permitted to conduct such tests.
 
• Certification involves proper training, testing, and sometimes licensing to meet legal and organisational standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Training and Certification:**
 
 
• Personnel must complete designated training programs to learn vehicle mechanics and road safety protocols.
 
• Certification ensures they meet required competency levels for conducting road tests safely.
 
 
 
• **Safety Protocols:**
 
 
• Adhering to safety protocols reduces the risk of accidents during road tests.
 
• Protocols include wearing safety gear, following traffic rules, and conducting pre-test vehicle checks.
